title: Phase-dependent redirect map
statement: Define a partial map between phase-indexed control states as follows: in the increment phase, the completed state carrying `true` redirects to the exit phase, while the completed state carrying `false` redirects to the extend phase in its running state. In the extend phase, the nested completed state redirects to the exit phase; every other phase and control state has no redirect.
